articles.title: Lumen shifts focus to strategic services, cuts legacy infrastructure
articles.content:
Lumen Technologies is actively expanding its strategic service offerings while simultaneously phasing out legacy infrastructure to improve overall business profitability, according to a recent report by CRN.

During its third-quarter 2026 earnings call, Lumen President and CEO Kate Johnson highlighted a 20% increase in global public internet backbone traffic, driven largely by a 1,000% surge in artificial intelligence-related demand since April. To support this growth, the Monroe, Louisiana-based company secured $700 million in new Private Connectivity Fabric agreements and integrated cloud networking specialist Alkira to bolster its Network as a Service platform. Currently, over 4,000 customers utilize the company's network services.

Simultaneously, the firm is accelerating the decommissioning of legacy copper infrastructure across states including Iowa, Florida, Nevada, and Utah, targeting 25% of its total copper footprint. While total business revenue dipped 4% to $2.35 billion, strategic revenues grew 10% to $1.28 billion. The company also expanded its partnership with Microsoft to integrate the Lumen platform into enterprise sales motions, aiming to capture demand where cloud and network modernization intersect. Despite these strategic pivots, the company reported a net loss of $265 million for the quarter, missing Wall Street expectations.

Source: CRN

articles.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
articles.content:
Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder’s web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

The security firm Layer3 Intel said it detected multiple residential proxy nodes beaconing out from the internet address network reserved for the Executive Office of the President (AS2650). Layer3 said the proxy activity was relatively persistent between October 5 to November 3, and that a review of the proxies available from AS2650 showed they exited from the White House network 236 times during that period.

The proxy tracking company Synthient said on Twitter/X that the activity it saw coming from AS2650 was related to multiple Windows 11 installations of a service called Infatica, a proxy program that is often integrated into “free” mobile and desktop applications. Infatica’s founder Vladimir Fomenko is a Russian man whose hosting firm King Servers was home to six of the eight internet addresses used by Russia’s state security services to compromise databases for election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

Synthient’s depiction of the outgoing proxy traffic from the dedicated White House network (AS2650). Click to enlarge.

There are dozens of residential proxy providers with varying degrees of legitimacy, many of them based in China or Russia. But at a minimum, they all make it simple for customers to rent someone else’s internet address as a way to anonymize their web traffic or spoof their true location. From a website’s perspective, the traffic from a proxy network user appears to originate from the rented IP address, not from the proxy service customer.

Layer3 Intel said the proxy exit nodes at the White House came from six internet addresses, on 26 of the 30 days, and that most of the activity happens in the evening, between 5 p.m. and midnight.

Incredibly, Infatica was not the only proxy service that reportedly has been reselling access to White House internet addresses: Layer3 Intel said it found 28 separate residential proxy services were able to exit through this network.

“This is public access,” the Layer3 Intel team wrote. “Anybody can obtain it by signing up to a public residential proxy service, paying a few dollars and sending requests through it. We did not selectively target this network or try to make our probes exit from it. We caught this by chance, simply by requesting global rotating access through these services.”

The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

As detailed in several stories here over the past year, residential proxy services are a major source of unwanted and often malicious traffic, including account takeover and other cybercrime activity, advertising fraud, and mass content scraping for AI projects.

They can also introduce serious security risks. In late 2025, it was discovered that cybercriminals were mass exploiting a widespread vulnerability in these services that allowed them to probe each proxy endpoint’s local network for vulnerable systems to infect with malware. In January 2026, dozens of proxy services were forced to patch their networks after Synthient Founder Ben Brundage showed how cybercriminals were abusing a vulnerability in these residential proxy services to seize control over devices inside the local networks of unsuspecting users.

“Some of these resellers sell bandwidth for as low as 60 cents a Gigabyte, that means for less than a dollar you can gain access into some of the most confidential and trusted networks,” Brundage told KrebsOnSecurity. “The reseller ecosystem further enables this with any criminal able to buy access while skipping KYC [Know Your Customer] processes.”

All too often, these proxy services are beaconing out from employee devices brought into the workplace. App developers can embed software development kits (SDKs) provided by the residential proxy networks to monetize their software, allowing them to receive a small amount of money on each installation.

As risky as residential proxies can be for unsuspecting end users, they are all too commonly found on government and corporate networks. In a webinar in January 2026, the proxy tracking service Spur found residential proxies in nearly 300 government owned and operated networks, 318 utility companies, 166 healthcare companies or hospitals, and 141 companies in banking and finance. In a blog post earlier this year, the security firm Infoblox said it discovered that fully 65% of its customer base was querying one or more residential proxy related domains.

articles.title: Pakistani Judge Fears Being Shot Over Blasphemy Cases As Christian Advocate Demands Protection
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

ISLAMABAD, PAKISTAN (Worthy News) – A senior Pakistani judge revealed Wednesday that he feared being shot inside his courtroom while hearing blasphemy-related cases, prompting a Christian human rights advocate to warn that threats and intimidation are undermining justice in the predominantly Muslim nation.

Islamabad High Court Justice Sardar Ejaz Ishaq Khan made the extraordinary disclosure during a hearing involving appeals by people convicted under Pakistan’s controversial blasphemy laws.

The judge said he feared someone could enter the courtroom, shoot him and walk away. He acknowledged that security concerns were discouraging judges from hearing sensitive appeals and questioned the state’s failure to protect judicial officials and witnesses.

His remarks prompted an urgent appeal from Christian human rights lawyer Sardar Mushtaq Gill, founder and international advocacy director of the rights group LEAD Ministries, who warned that even judges were struggling to perform their duties without fear of violence.

Gill told Worthy News that the judge’s observations raised serious questions about judicial independence, the rule of law and the state’s ability to protect ordinary citizens facing blasphemy accusations.

JUDGES UNDER PRESSURE

Justice Khan spoke during proceedings before a two-member Islamabad High Court bench that also included Justice Khadim Hussain Soomro.

Despite his security fears, the court suspended the remaining sentence of a blasphemy convict who had five months and 25 days left to serve and ordered his release on bail against surety bonds of 100,000 Pakistani rupees (about $362). The main appeals were scheduled for hearing two weeks later.

Khan criticized the state for failing to provide adequate protection to judges and witnesses, questioning why appeals in such cases had remained pending for years. He also expressed concern that speaking openly could result in another disciplinary reference being filed against him.

Gill warned that intimidation extended beyond those accused of blasphemy to lawyers, witnesses, journalists, human rights defenders and their families.

“If a judge fears being shot inside a courtroom for hearing a blasphemy-related case, what protection can an ordinary accused person, a witness, a lawyer, or a human rights defender realistically expect?” Gill asked.

BLASPHEMY VIOLENCE

Pakistan’s blasphemy legislation criminalizes offenses deemed insulting to religion, including provisions carrying the death penalty for insulting Islam’s Prophet Muhammad.

Critics say the laws have contributed to a climate of hatred and intimidation. According to Pakistan’s Centre for Social Justice, at least 104 people were killed in mob violence and other extrajudicial attacks following blasphemy accusations between 1994 and 2024, including 26 Christians. Ten people were killed in 2024 alone.

A British government report published in July 2026, citing U.S. religious freedom monitors, identified at least 18 Christians imprisoned or detained on blasphemy charges, including nine serving death or life sentences. Pakistan has not carried out any state-sanctioned executions for blasphemy.

Human rights organizations have warned that blasphemy allegations are sometimes used to settle personal disputes, intimidate religious minorities or seize property, while accused individuals can spend years in prison awaiting justice.

Christians, who account for a small minority of Pakistan’s population, have faced mob attacks, prosecutions and threats following accusations that are sometimes unsupported by credible evidence, Worthy News observed.

PREVIOUS INVESTIGATION

Justice Khan has previously challenged the handling of blasphemy cases. In July 2025, he ordered the government to establish an inquiry commission to investigate allegations of entrapment, deaths in custody, flawed investigations and violations of fundamental rights.

However, another Islamabad High Court bench suspended the order, saying such an investigation could interfere with cases pending before other courts.

Gill said the latest judicial disclosures underscored the need for stronger safeguards and independent legal proceedings.

“No judge should have to fear assassination for performing judicial duties. No witness should have to risk their life for telling the truth. No lawyer should face intimidation for representing an accused person,” he stressed.

CALL FOR PROTECTION

Gill urged Pakistan’s government, judicial authorities and law enforcement agencies to strengthen security for judges handling blasphemy cases and establish effective protection mechanisms for witnesses, lawyers, accused individuals and their families.

He also called for investigations into threats against judicial officials and warned that prolonged delays in appeals could have devastating consequences for defendants awaiting justice.

The Christian advocate appealed to United Nations human rights mechanisms, diplomatic missions and international organizations to monitor the situation and press for stronger safeguards.

“The state must not allow threats, intimidation, or fear of violence to determine which cases can be heard and which individuals can obtain justice,” Gill stressed.

“A courtroom should be a place where the law speaks without fear, not a place where judges fear for their lives,” he argued.

The post Pakistani Judge Fears Being Shot Over Blasphemy Cases As Christian Advocate Demands Protection appeared first on Worthy Christian News.

articles.title: Uganda Sentences Eight To Death For Killing Alleged Christian Evangelists (Worthy News Investigation)
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

KAMPALA, UGANDA (Worthy News) – A court in Uganda has sentenced eight men to death for murdering two fishermen near Lake Victoria in 2024, in a case that Christian witnesses say involved the killing of evangelists because of their faith in Jesus Christ.

The High Court in Iganga, a town in eastern Uganda, convicted the eight defendants of murdering Robert Bagume and Moses Okech in nearby Namayingo District, near the shores of Lake Victoria, on August 19, 2024. The death sentences were handed down on October 7 following a judgment dated September 30, Worthy News established.

Morning Star News, a Christian news agency citing witnesses and residents, reported that the victims had been sharing the Gospel with fishermen for about three months before they were attacked.

Witnesses alleged that Muslim assailants accused the two men of misleading local people through their Christian preaching, tore their Bibles apart and shouted religious slogans during the assault.

However, court documents reviewed by Worthy News⁠ describe a mob attack following accusations of theft and assault, without establishing anti-Christian sentiments as the motive.

LAKE VICTORIA KILLINGS

“They were intercepted on Lake Victoria where they had gone fishing, tied their hands from behind with a rope,” High Court Justice David Batema wrote in his judgment.

The judge found that the men were subsequently beaten to death by a mob. Medical evidence established that they died from traumatic brain injuries.

According to the judgment, witnesses identified seven defendants who seized the men near the lake and took them to the home of Odongo Misaki, then the local council chairman of Bukewa Central village.

The court heard that the chairman slapped Bagume and handed the two men over to an angry crowd rather than arranging for their transfer to police custody.

Justice Batema concluded that all eight defendants were criminally responsible for the murders, rejecting their denials of involvement.

EIGHT CONVICTED OF MURDER

Those convicted included Misaki, Karoli Lwanga, Musoke Yakuti, Kabwiso Mairadi, Talisuna Muzaham, Wandera Karim, Wasire Pius and Latifu Nyanga.

The judge found that several defendants used a pickaxe, sticks and stones during the killings, while the council chairman facilitated the violence by surrendering the victims to the mob.

A Christian woman who claimed to have witnessed the killings and testified during the trial maintained that the attackers had challenged the victims’ faith and accused them of converting people to Christianity.

“You infidels, why are you misleading our people?” the witness recalled the assailants shouting, according to the Christian news agency.

The woman, whose identity was withheld for security reasons, explained that she had embraced Christianity after hearing the two evangelists preach.

CHRISTIAN WITNESSES SPEAK

She claimed that the assailants were among local fishermen who had previously heard the two men share the Gospel and that religious hostility motivated the attack.

The agency also quoted the victims’ pastor, whose name was withheld for security reasons, as welcoming the convictions after a prolonged search for justice.

“We have been following this case since it happened, and indeed we have received justice from this honorable court,” the pastor explained.

Yet, the published judgment describes prosecution testimony that Bagume had been accused of assaulting fishermen, using their boats without permission and stealing property. The differing accounts of the motive could not immediately be reconciled.

Uganda’s continued use of capital punishment has also drawn renewed attention following the death sentences, although the country has not executed a civilian prisoner since April 1999.

DEATH PENALTY IN UGANDA

It was not immediately clear whether the convicted men had appealed their sentences. Under Ugandan law, they can challenge the verdicts through the courts, while President Yoweri Museveni has the constitutional authority to pardon them or commute their death sentences.

Uganda’s constitution guarantees freedom of religion, including the right to preach and change one’s faith. According to the 2024 national census, Christians account for about 82 percent of the population, while Muslims represent 13.2 percent.

Christian investigators have documented other alleged attacks on converts and evangelists in eastern Uganda. In February 2025, an evangelist was reportedly stabbed and three colleagues beaten following a public conversion to Christianity in Mukono District.

These incidents highlighted broader concerns among Christians about the safety of evangelists and converts, including former Muslims, in parts of Uganda.

The latest eight death sentences also demonstrated the willingness of Uganda’s courts to impose the country’s most severe punishment for mob killings, including on a local community leader found guilty of facilitating the violence.

It was unclear whether the Ugandan verdict would have wider legal consequences elsewhere in East Africa, where religious differences can contribute to deadly clashes.

However, for the families of Bagume and Okech, the convictions mark a major development more than two years after their loved ones were murdered near the shores of Lake Victoria.

The post Uganda Sentences Eight To Death For Killing Alleged Christian Evangelists (Worthy News Investigation) appeared first on Worthy Christian News.

articles.title: Searching for John Foxe and His Book of Martyrs
articles.content:
Foxe’s Book of Martyrs was first published in English nearly five hundred years ago (1563). Today, there are many editions of this book available because it is in the public domain. When Lighthouse Trails decided to start offering this book to our readers several years ago, we began our search for a suitable edition. Much to our dismay, we discovered that many of the current editions were compromised in one form or another. For example, in one edition by a Christian publisher, front-page endorsements included the names of practitioners of contemplative prayer (a spirituality that thrives from the impetus of the Roman Catholic Church and embraces some of the same beliefs that Foxe’s martyrs opposed to the point of suffering cruel persecution and death). It is most troubling to see such names in the cover of an edition of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs.

In another edition we reviewed in our search, the book was among a special set of “Christian classics.” We were once again perplexed to see that some of the other books in that series were written by contemplative mystics.

And yet another edition, published by a secular publisher, advertised mystical and occult practices on the back cover. Such things can happen when a book goes into the public domain.

Worth noting, in John Foxe’s original Book of Martyrs, Foxe wrote much about persecutions coming from the Catholic Church. But in some of today’s editions, you will find stories of this papal persecution omitted. One very popular large Christian organization did such a thing as this quote from The Berean Call documents:

Foxe’s Book of Martyrs is best known for its recounting of history and compilation of brief biographies of Christians killed by the Roman Catholic Church. In 2007, the organization Voice of the Martyrs published a volume titled FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs, with the authors listed as “John Foxe and The Voice of the Martyrs.”

Despite its name, the book FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs bears no resemblance to Foxe’s Book of Martyrs. The modern book omits Foxe’s history, with no mention of the Inquisition, of which Foxe said, “In the space of one hundred and twenty nine years, the inquisition deprived Spain of three millions of inhabitants”1 (a subject to which Foxe devoted an entire chapter). It also makes no mention of God sparing England from both the assault of the Spanish Armada and from the “conspiracy by the Papists” to blow up both houses of Parliament and the royal family, a conspiracy known as The Gunpowder Plot of 1605 (these were the subject of another chapter by Foxe).2

When FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs makes mention of persons from Foxe’s Book of Martyrs, the writer removes most of Foxe’s points. The book even includes at least a dozen Roman Catholics cited as martyrs.3 [VOM’s] FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs goes so far as to include a section on the Jesuits that begins with the paean, “Founded by Ignatius of Loyola in 1540, the Jesuits have been the most successful missionary movement in the Catholic Church.”4 [For those not familiar with the Jesuits, they were a Catholic order set up to bring people into the Catholic Church either by coercion or force and to bring an end to the Protestant reformation.]5

Finally, after an unsuccessful search, for an edition of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs that we could offer to our readers, Lighthouse Trails decided to publish its own edition of this truly incredible and unforgettable account. We released that edition in 2010, which included John Foxe’s chapters on the Inquisition and papal persecutions.

And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him. (Colossians 3: 17)

Below the endnotes is an excerpt from the Lighthouse Trails edition of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs: “Papal Persecution in France”

Endnotes:
1 www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/22400/pg22400.txt, Chapter V, pp. 73-106.
2. www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/22400/pg22400.txt, Chapter XIV, pp. 298-314.
3. John Foxe and The Voice of the Martyrs, FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs (Bridge-Logos, 2007), pp. 103, 147, 149, 151, 189, 194, 231, 238, 207, 327.
4. Read Roger Oakland’s The Jesuit Agenda: Understanding the Jesuit Agenda and the Evangelical/Protestant Church: https://www.lighthousetrailsresearch.com/blog/special-report-the-jesuit-agenda-and-the-evangelicalprotestant-church/.
5. FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs, p. 147. The paragraphs in this section are taken from The Berean Call’s April 1, 2026 article, “Faithful Scribes” (https://www.thebereancall.org/content/faithful-scribes-part-two).

From the chapter in the Lighthouse Trails edition of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs: “Papal Persecutions in France”

By John Foxe

Thus far our history of persecution has been confined principally to the pagan world. We come now to a period when persecution, under the guise of Christianity, committed more extreme acts of violence than ever disgraced the annals of paganism. Disregarding the maxims and the spirit of the gospel, the Roman Catholic Church, arming herself with the power of the sword, vexed the church of God and wasted it for several centuries. This period is most appropriately termed in history, the “Dark Ages.” The kings of the earth gave their power to the “beast” and submitted to be trodden on by the miserable vermin that often filled the papal chair.

The Bartholomew Massacre at Paris

On the twenty second day of August, 1572, commenced this diabolical act of blood-thirsty brutality. It was intended to destroy at one stroke the root of the Protestant tree, which had only before partially suffered in its branches. Coligny, an admiral and prince of the Protestants, as he was coming from the Council, was shot in both arms. As this was clearly an assassination attempt, he was advised to flee, yet he remained in Paris. Soon after he was slain by Bemjus; who afterward declared he never saw a man meet death more valiantly than the admiral.

The soldiers were appointed upon Admiral Coligny’s demise, to burst out instantly to the slaughter in all parts of the city. When they had killed the admiral, they threw him out a window into the street, where his head was cut off and sent to the pope. The savage papists, still raging against him, cut off his arms and private members, and after dragging him three days through the streets, hung him by the heels outside the city. After him they slew many great and honorable persons who were Protestants . . . and falling upon the common people, they continued the slaughter for many days. In the first three days, they slew of all ranks and conditions to the number of ten thousand. The bodies were thrown into the rivers and blood ran through the streets with a strong current, and the river appeared presently like a stream of blood. So furious was their hellish rage that they even slew all papists whom they suspected to be not very staunch to their diabolical religion.

From Paris the destruction spread to all quarters of the realm. At Orleans, a thousand were slain of men, women, and children, and six thousand at Rouen. At Meldith, two hundred were put into prison, and later brought out by units and cruelly murdered.
At Lyons, eight hundred were massacred. Here children hanging about their parents, and parents affectionately embracing their children, were pleasant food for the swords and bloodthirsty minds of those who call themselves the Catholic Church. Here three hundred were slain in the bishop’s house; and the impious monks would allow none to be buried.

At Augustobona, when the people heard of the massacre at Paris, they shut their gates that no Protestants might escape, and searching diligently for every individual of the reformed Church, imprisoned and then barbarously murdered them. The same cruelty they practiced at Avaricum, at Troys, at Toulouse, Rouen and many other places, running from city to city, in towns and villages throughout the kingdom.

Some days after this horrid transaction, the French court endeavored to excuse it by forms of law. They pretended to justify the massacre by defamation and accused the Admiral Coligny of a conspiracy, which no one believed. . . .

This horrid butchery was not confined merely to the city of Paris. The same orders were issued from court to the governors of all the provinces in France; so that, in a week’s time about one hundred thousand Protestants were cut to pieces in different parts of France!

At Rome the horrid joy was so great that they appointed a day of high festival and a jubilee with great indulgence to all who kept it and showed every expression of gladness. . . . At Bordeaux, at the instigation of a villainous monk who used to urge the papists to slaughter in his sermons, two hundred and sixty-four were cruelly murdered; some of them senators. Another of the same pious fraternity produced a similar slaughter at Agendicum, in Maine, where the populace at the holy inquisitors’ satanic suggestion, ran upon the Protestants, slew them, plundered their houses, and pulled down their church.

The duke of Guise, entering into Blois, suffered his soldiers to fly upon the spoil and slay or drown all the Protestants they could find. In this they spared neither age nor sex, defiling the women and then murdering them. From there he went to Mere, and committed the same outrages for many days together. Here they found a minister named Cassebonius and threw him into the river. . . . At Anjou, they slew Albiacus, a minister, and many women were defiled and murdered there. Among these were two sisters, abused before their father, whom the assassins bound to a wall so he could see them, and then slew them and him. . . . At Samarobridge they murdered above one hundred Protestants after promising them peace; and at Antsidor one hundred were killed and cast part into a public toilet and part into a river. One hundred put into a prison at Orleans, were destroyed by the furious multitude.

The tragic sufferings of the Protestants are too numerous to detail.

Editor’s Note: This is just a small section of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs that describes papal persecutions.

articles.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
articles.content:
Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user’s Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet’s access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.

A report from the Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) said Google has severed ties with Videostrong Technology Co., a TV box manufacturer in China that GTIG and other industry experts concluded was responsible for including malware that enrolled more than 1.3 million set-top boxes in a botnet dubbed “XCPE” (named after one of the malware’s core code components).

The global distribution of XCPE botnet infections. Image: Google Threat Intelligence Group.

The report said the XCPE botnet loaded the user’s device with software that makes their Internet address available for resale by multiple “residential proxy” services, which allow customers to rent Internet addresses as a way to anonymize their web traffic or spoof their true location. As detailed in several stories here over the past year, residential proxy services are a major source of unwanted and often malicious traffic, including account takeover activity, advertising fraud, and mass content scraping for AI projects.

“Videostrong monetized the backdoor by selling access to criminal affiliates and loading those affiliates’ malware modules onto infected devices,” the GTIG post reads, noting that Google took legal action to take down the domains and servers Videostrong used to control the botnet and install additional malware. “A device manufacturer intentionally infecting their users with malware is an unacceptable breach of trust, and represents a serious risk to those users. Without users’ knowledge or consent, infected devices were offered as a distribution mechanism for a wide array of criminal actors.”

The report notes that while TV boxes made up the the majority of the botnet, the same XCPE malware was found in other Android-based IoT products, including telehealth devices, karaoke machines, and even digital signage systems.

Google said it requires all Android device makers to pass compatibility and security tests to ensure their products don’t harm users, but that Videostrong nevertheless found a way to load their malicious software immediately after a user boots up one of these devices for the first time (Google says it has since addressed that weakness).

The GTIG report calls out a number of residential proxy providers whose software development kits were routinely downloaded by devices infected by the XCPE botnet. Those include AppSalt, also known as Honeygain, which was developed by the Vilnius, Lithuania-based Oxylabs. In October 2026, Oxylabs and Honeygain were reorganized as independent platforms under an umbrella entity called Source, which received $130 million in funding from private equity firm Warburg Pincus that reportedly valued the business at $3.6 billion.

Another provider linked to the botnet was NetNut, a once sprawling residential proxy company operated by the publicly-traded Israeli company Alarum Technologies. In July 2026, the FBI worked with industry partners to seize hundreds of domains associated with NetNut, saying the company was responsible for operating a separate botnet called Popa that enslaved TV boxes as residential proxies. Other proxy providers named in the GTIG report include EarnFM, Traffmonetizer, Jaguar, LINKFOG, BMW/IPWeb and GaGaNode.

Google’s announcement credits a number of industry partners, including Synthient, a startup that tracks proxy providers. In January 2026, Synthient published research into the rapid spread of the Kimwolf botnet, which at the time was hammering networks worldwide with record-smashing DDoS attacks. Synthient documented how Kimwolf infected millions of Android set-top boxes virtually overnight, using a widespread vulnerability in these residential proxy services to compromise other Android-based devices inside the local networks of unsuspecting TV box users.

Synthient’s research caused dozens of residential proxy providers to patch their networks, which helped to fragment the Kimwolf botnet into much smaller pieces that made its incessant and disruptive DDoS attacks far easier for network operators to manage. It also attracted the attention of the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing the major Hollywood studios, which partnered with Synthient to purchase and tear apart a number of popular Android TV set-top boxes — including some that were being infected by Kimwolf and other IoT botnets.

In a report published today, Synthient examined a popular, pre-infected TV box sold under the brand MECOOL by a publicly traded company in China called Skyworth Technology, concluding that MECOOL also bundled the malware from Videostrong Technology Co. and likewise installed AppSalt/Honeygain and other proxy components.

The MECOOL storefront and marketing. Image: Synthient.com.

Synthient founder Ben Brundage told KrebsOnSecurity that Videostrong’s malware also distributed software for the proxy service Grass. In our November 2025 story, “Is Your Android TV Streaming Box Part of a Botnet?” we quoted a researcher from Censys who found the popular Superbox TV streaming device bundled Grass’s residential proxy software. We also quoted the Grass founder, who denied any affiliation with the TV box maker.

That November 2025 story noted that Superbox and similar Android TV set-top boxes gain new customers primarily by engaging influencers on Tiktok and other social networks who praise the product’s ability to offer hundreds of (pirated) pay TV streaming services for a one-time fee.

Likewise, Synthient’s report observes that the MECOOL set-top boxes exploded in popularity after the product was mentioned in 2023 by the Youtube channel Linus Tech Tips, which has an audience of nearly 17 million subscribers [Linus Tech Tips said in a statement shared with Synthient that it has since updated the video to explicitly frame the product as a scam and have removed all associated affiliate links].

The popular Youtube channel Linus Tech Tips discussing MECOOL TV streaming boxes.

The GTIG report estimates the XCPE botnet takedown should sever access to at least 10 million additional compromised devices, noting that the various proxy and ad fraud affiliates of Videostrong “each have diversified distribution channels for their modules beyond XCPE.”

Synthient’s Brundage echoed that conclusion, calling the 1.3 million number “highly conservative.”

“The scale of affected devices is likely way higher,” he said. “This is probably the largest operation against backdoored TV boxes that we’ve seen.”

Update, Nov. 5, 11:07 a.m. ET: In a statement shared post-publication, Oxylabs said that while its system is built so that a device can’t be used as a proxy exit node unless they receive a signal that it has consented, the developer faked these signals.

“We have been conducting regular audits of the applications provided by our partners,” the statement reads. “However, following this incident, we will improve the application and application’s build fingerprinting logic to better detect cases where the SDK is running on an unapproved build of an originally authorized application.”

The statement said Oxylabs has no record of any company called Videostrong Technology Co., but it did find between is suppliers the domain “com.abc[.]nexus,” mentioned in the GTIG report as an external malware loader.

“As soon as we saw that, we suspended the relationship and sent them a formal legal inquiry,” the statement reads. “This supplier accounts for less than 1% of our IP address pool. We had a signed contract with them, they assured our QA team that users had given consent, and we saw the consent flow ourselves.”

Further reading:
Plume Security Labs white paper on the XCPE botnet (PDF)
Black Lotus Labs writeup on LinkedIn
TrendAI’s analysis

articles.title: Egyptian Coptic Christian Killed In Libya After Refusing To Renounce Faith (Worthy News Investigation)
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

TRIPOLI/CAIRO (Worthy News) – A young Egyptian Coptic Christian has died in Libya after being tortured by armed kidnappers for refusing to renounce his faith in Jesus Christ and convert to Islam, according to relatives and people familiar with his family.

Milad Malak, 20, who served as a deacon at a Coptic church in his home village of Sabrbay, traveled to Libya in search of employment amid economic hardship in Egypt.

Egyptian news website Safha1 blamed a cell affiliated with the Islamic State (IS) group for Malak’s abduction and killing. However, the allegation could not be independently verified, and IS had not claimed responsibility as of Monday.

His captors demanded that he abandon his Christian faith and embrace Islam, but Malak refused despite being subjected to severe abuse, according to Egyptian Christians familiar with the situation.

The young man’s sister, Madonna Malek, said in statements shared with Worthy News that the kidnappers tortured her brother after the family paid a ransom, but he remained steadfast in his Christian faith.

FAMILY SEEKS JUSTICE

“Milad traveled on September 2nd with two Muslim friends from his village. The last contact we had with him was on the morning of October 4th,” Madonna Malek recalled.

“Then, on the morning of Tuesday, October 6th—around 11:00 AM—we received a message from Milad informing us that he had been kidnapped and was being tortured. The kidnappers are demanding a ransom of $4,700 for his release,” she added.

The kidnappers held Malak alongside other Egyptian workers, including his two Muslim friends, in the western Libyan city of Zliten, according to family accounts.

Madonna Malek explained that the families of the two Muslim friends each paid the requested $4,700 ransom, securing their release. The survivors subsequently told Malak’s relatives what had happened to him.

“We transferred the requested ransom ($4,700), but after receiving the money, they did not release him,” she said.

REFUSING TO RENOUNCE FAITH

“Instead, they tortured him, demanding that he renounce his faith—yet he refused, telling them, ‘Even if you were to hack me to pieces, I would never renounce my faith,’” Madonna Malek stressed.

“They subjected him to all manner of torture until he attained martyrdom,” she said.

The two surviving Muslim friends returned to Egypt, where they were receiving medical treatment, according to Coptic media. Christian advocacy group Open Doors also cited the survivors’ accounts of the pressure placed on Malak to renounce his faith.

The precise circumstances and date of Malak’s death have not been independently established.

His mother, Maryam Fawzi, appealed to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and the country’s Foreign Ministry to help recover her son’s remains so the family could give him a Christian burial.

CHRISTIAN FUNERAL

“I have been praying with her,” a friend of the family told Worthy News. “He was faithful to Christ till his last breath.”

The friend, an evangelical church worker who requested anonymity for security reasons in Muslim-majority Egypt, confirmed that Malak’s body was eventually returned to Egypt.

Funeral prayers were held October 28 at the historic Church of the Archangel Michael in his home village of Sabrbay, near the city of Tanta in Egypt’s northern Nile Delta region, about 90 kilometers (56 miles) north of Cairo.

Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral, including clergy and members of the local Coptic Christian community, Worthy News learned.

Malak’s killing has renewed concerns about the safety of Egyptian Coptic Christians working in Libya, where Christians have previously faced kidnappings, violence and killings by Islamist militants.

LIBYAN CHRISTIAN MARTYRS

His murder also revived memories of the February 2015 execution of 21 Christians, including 20 Egyptian Coptic migrant workers and one Ghanaian, by Islamic State group militants on a Libyan beach.

These killings shocked Egypt and the wider Christian world after IS released a video showing the men being beheaded. The victims became widely known as the 21 Coptic martyrs of Libya.

The latest killing has highlighted the dangers facing Egyptian Christians who travel to neighboring Libya in search of employment amid economic pressures at home.

Egypt itself ranks 42nd on the 2026 World Watch List of 50 countries where Christians face the most severe persecution, published by Christian advocacy group Open Doors.

However, the situation is considerably worse in Libya, which ranks ninth. Open Doors says Christians there face threats from Islamist militants and criminal gangs, including kidnappings, forced labor and killings, amid continued political instability.

Open Doors estimates that about 10.2 million Christians remain in Egypt, representing 8.8 percent of its population, compared with just 36,300 Christians in Libya, or about 0.5 percent of its population.

articles.title: Pakistan Christian Advocate Demands Action Over Forced Conversions Of Minority Girls (Worthy News Investigation)
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

ISLAMABAD, PAKISTAN (Worthy News) – A prominent Pakistani Christian human rights advocate has urged Pakistan’s government to investigate allegations of forced religious conversions and child marriages involving Hindu and Christian girls, warning that influential religious figures must not be allowed to operate above the law in the Islamic nation.

Lawyer Sardar Mushtaq Gill, founder and international advocacy director of the Christian advocacy group LEAD Ministries, said authorities should heed concerns raised by Senator Danesh Kumar about the reported abduction and forced conversion of minority girls, including minors.

Senator Kumar challenged police officials during a Senate committee meeting over their handling of such cases, including the disappearance of 14-year-old Hindu girl Bindiya Kumari, who was allegedly abducted in mid-October from the town of Sibi in southwestern Pakistan’s Balochistan province and taken to neighboring Sindh.

Participants also examined allegations against Mian Mitho, a powerful Muslim religious figure in Pakistan’s southern Sindh province. Minister of State for Religious Affairs Kesoo Mal Khael Das accused him of involvement in the abduction, forced conversion and marriage of minority girls.

Mian Mitho, whose real name is Mian Abdul Haq, has previously denied involvement in forced religious conversions, insisting they are voluntary and that coercion violates Islamic teachings.

POWERFUL RELIGIOUS FIGURES

However, the committee expressed concern about his influence, describing his activities as a “state within a state,” and questioned why authorities had failed to take effective action against him.

Police officials told the committee that a court petition had prevented them from taking action. Legal representatives challenged the document’s authenticity, prompting Kumar to demand an investigation into its origins.

Police requested seven days to report back after being directed to recover Bindiya Kumari.

Gill called for an independent investigation, insisting that religious status or political influence must not place anyone above the law.

“No individual should be above the law. Religious status, political connections, wealth or local influence must never become protection against investigation or prosecution,” Gill told Worthy News.

MINORITY GIRL’S DISAPPEARANCE

He also demanded the immediate recovery of Bindiya Kumari and called for independent safeguards to protect her from possible intimidation or coercion.

“An underage girl is a child who deserves protection, not exploitation,” Gill stressed, urging authorities to investigate the circumstances surrounding her reported disappearance and religious conversion.

Pakistan has faced scrutiny over the alleged abduction, forced religious conversion and marriage of Christian and Hindu girls. The Pakistani rights group Centre for Social Justice documented 94 cases involving minority women and girls in 2025, including 71 Hindus and 23 Christians, compared with 83 cases in 2024.

Earlier estimates suggested that as many as 1,000 Christian and Hindu women and girls faced forced conversions and marriages annually, although activists say the true scale remains difficult to establish because many cases go unreported.

Christian advocacy group Open Doors ranks Pakistan eighth on its 2026 World Watch List of 50 countries where it says Christians face the most severe persecution. The organization, which estimates that about 4.8 million Christians live in Pakistan, roughly 1.9 percent of the population, warns that Christian girls as young as seven “face abduction, rape, forced marriage and conversion.”

RELIGIOUS MINORITIES AT RISK

Besides Christians, Pakistan’s 2023 census recorded about 5.2 million Hindus, including members of historically disadvantaged Hindu caste communities described as Scheduled Castes, representing roughly 2.2 percent of the population.

Open Doors also highlighted the vulnerability of Christian families living in poverty, adding that weak law enforcement and the influence of extremist groups often leave victims without adequate protection.

Separately, in an open letter shared with Worthy News, Gill urged Pakistan’s Christian leaders to overcome disagreements over proposed family law reforms aimed at protecting Christian women, children and marriages.

He called for a minimum marriage age of 18, stronger protections against domestic violence and fairer rules on divorce, child custody and inheritance.

Gill also urged lawmakers to respect Biblical principles and religious freedom while ensuring equal rights for Christian families.

CHRISTIAN FAMILY LAW REFORMS

“The absence of comprehensive, clear, and properly enacted Christian family laws could have far-reaching consequences for the entire community,” he warned.

Gill urged church leaders, politicians and human rights advocates to work together despite their religious and political differences.

He proposed bringing together Catholic, Protestant and Evangelical leaders, alongside legal experts and women’s rights advocates, to discuss reforms and find common ground on protecting Christian families.

Gill also called on international organizations and churches to press Pakistan to better protect its Christian and Hindu minorities.

“Our objective should not be to defeat one another’s positions, but to develop legislation that protects every Christian family, respects every legitimate religious tradition, safeguards individual rights, and upholds the dignity of Pakistan’s Christian community,” Gill wrote.

The post Pakistan Christian Advocate Demands Action Over Forced Conversions Of Minority Girls (Worthy News Investigation) appeared first on Worthy Christian News.

articles.title: China Interrogates Christian Schoolchildren Amid Church Crackdown
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

BEIJING (Worthy News) – Chinese authorities have interrogated Christian schoolchildren, including first graders, for hours and pressured them to sign statements accusing their churches of religious “brainwashing,” Christian rights activists confirmed Friday.

The interrogations in China’s central Hunan province are part of an expanding crackdown on unregistered Protestant congregations that has also led to the suspension of Christian educators, according to the advocacy organization ChinaAid.

Some children were questioned for three to four hours by police officers and pressured to provide information about their churches, the group reported, citing local Christians.

In one case, an elementary-school-aged boy broke down in tears after officers demanded that he sign a document criticizing his church. “I don’t know anything. I want to go home. I won’t sign. Don’t force me,” the child pleaded, according to Christians familiar with the incident.

CHRISTIAN CHILDREN QUESTIONED

ChinaAid said police visited several primary and secondary schools in Yueyang, where children from Christian families were questioned individually. Some signed statements accusing their churches of religious indoctrination, while others refused.

The youngest child questioned was a first grader, according to local Christians, raising concerns among families about the psychological impact of the interrogations.

At the Hunan Institute of Technology, a female instructor was suspended from teaching duties and placed on standby status, local Christians cited by ChinaAid explained. Another educator, identified by the surname Zhou, faced similar disciplinary action after requesting to withdraw from the ruling Chinese Communist Party because of his Christian faith.

At Yueyang No. 1 Secondary School, the school’s Communist Party secretary questioned a teacher about attending a Bible study group organized by detained church elder Yang Jianjun, ChinaAid reported. When the educator defended his right to study Scripture, officials warned that state security authorities would investigate him, according to Christians familiar with the incident.

CHURCH LEADERS DETAINED

The school interrogations followed coordinated police raids on several unregistered churches in Yueyang on July 11, when numerous believers, including children and teenagers, were taken into custody for questioning, said Christian activists.

ChinaAid reported that six church leaders and workers remained detained as of late September. Three faced allegations of “illegal use of information networks” after authorities transferred them from administrative to criminal detention, according to local Christians.

Those detained included Pastor Huang Lei, Elder Yang Jianjun and preacher Hu Hongtao, along with Pastor Luo Kaimin and two other church members, Christian activists reported.

During the July raids, police collected fingerprints, DNA samples, voice recordings and other personal information from believers, according to ChinaAid. Several Christians released after questioning claimed officers accused those refusing to join government-sanctioned churches of belonging to a “cult.”

RELIGIOUS FREEDOM CONCERNS

China officially recognizes Protestant Christianity through the government-controlled Three-Self Patriotic Movement, but many believers worship in independent congregations known as house churches.

Under President Xi Jinping, the Communist Party has tightened oversight of religious activities, requiring religious organizations to comply with state regulations and policies promoting loyalty to the party.

China ranks 17th on the 2026 World Watch List of 50 countries where Christians face the most severe persecution, said its publisher, Open Doors.

The Christian advocacy organization estimates that about 96.7 million Christians live in China, representing 6.8 percent of its population.

CHINA DEFENDS RELIGIOUS POLICIES

Open Doors says authorities increasingly restrict religious activities involving minors, with children under 18 barred from attending government-registered churches and Christian families facing pressure over religious education.

The Chinese government denies wrongdoing. It says China’s constitution guarantees freedom of religious belief but that religious organizations must operate in accordance with national laws and regulations.

Beijing has defended its policies as necessary to maintain social stability and ensure that religious activities remain consistent with China’s political and legal system. There was no immediate publicly documented official response to the specific allegations involving schoolchildren in Yueyang.

However, ChinaAid founder and president Bob Fu condemned the interrogations, arguing that authorities were extending religious repression beyond church buildings into family and school life.

FAMILIES FACE PRESSURE

“This crackdown on faith has ultimately become a collective trampling of basic human dignity and childhood,” Fu warned.

Christian parents in Hunan have expressed growing fears about sending their children to school, while homeschooling remains difficult due to government restrictions and scrutiny, according to local believers.

Voice of the Martyrs Canada (VOMC), which highlighted the developments Thursday, urged Christians worldwide to pray for affected families, children and educators who have faced disciplinary measures because of their faith.

For Christian families in Yueyang, the announced interrogations have added a new dimension to the pressure on independent congregations, with even young children now facing questions from authorities about their Christian faith.

The post China Interrogates Christian Schoolchildren Amid Church Crackdown appeared first on Worthy Christian News.

articles.title: Paus dan Kepala Gereja Inggris
articles.content:
Sumber: www.wayoflife.org

“Gereja” esa-sedunia sedang menunjukkan kemajuan pesat dalam persiapannya menuju wujud penuh “Misteri Babel” sebagaimana tertulis dalam Wahyu 17. Pada tahun 1521, Martin Luther dikucilkan oleh Paus Leo X, dan Reformasi Protestan pun dimulai, dengan gereja-gereja Lutheran menyebar ke seluruh wilayah Jerman dan Skandinavia. Pada tahun 1525, Ulrich Zwingli memisahkan diri dari Roma di Zurich, Swiss, dan memimpin gerakan Protestan di wilayah tersebut. Pada tahun 1530, John Calvin memisahkan diri dari Roma, dan enam tahun kemudian menerbitkan Institutio Christianae Religionis (Pengajaran Agama Kristen), yang menjadi landasan doktrinal bagi gereja-gereja Protestan Presbiterian dan Reformed. Pada tahun 1534, Raja Henry VIII memisahkan diri dari Roma dan mendirikan Gereja Inggris (Church of England) dengan dirinya sendiri sebagai kepalanya. Antara tahun 1545–1563, Konsili Trente dari Gereja Katolik Roma melontarkan 125 anathema (kutukan hukuman kekal) terhadap semua orang Kristen non-Katolik, termasuk mereka yang meyakini bahwa keselamatan diperoleh semata-mata oleh kasih karunia Allah tanpa perbuatan baik.

Kini, sejak abad ke-20, kita menyaksikan pembalikan arah dari Reformasi serta penyatuan ekumenis antara pihak Protestan dan Roma. Peristiwa berikut ini merupakan langkah terbaru dalam rekonsiliasi Gereja Inggris dengan Roma. Dikutip dari “Raja Inggris menganugerahkan sebuah kehormatan,” Zenit News, 23 Oktober 2026: “Paus Leo XIV telah menerima gelar kehormatan di Kapel St. George, Kastel Windsor. Penerimaan ini melengkapi pertukaran simbolis persaudaraan dengan Raja Charles III, yang menandai perbaikan hubungan secara bertahap antara Gereja Katolik dan tradisi Anglikan. Pengumuman tersebut disampaikan pada 23 Oktober 2026 oleh Dekan dan para Kanon Windsor, dengan persetujuan dari monarki Inggris serta dukungan dari Uskup Agung Canterbury. Paus telah diangkat sebagai Papal Confrater (anggota persaudaraan kehormatan) di College of St. George — sebuah gestur yang digambarkan oleh pihak Istana Kerajaan sebagai wujud nyata dari persekutuan rohani, persahabatan ekumenis, dan persaudaraan Kristiani. Pengangkatan ini terjadi tepat satu tahun setelah kunjungan kenegaraan bersejarah Raja Charles III dan Ratu Camilla ke Vatikan pada 23 Oktober 2025, di mana pasangan kerajaan tersebut bertemu dengan Leo XIV dan mengunjungi sejumlah situs keagamaan penting, termasuk Kapel Sistina dan Kapel Paulina. Dalam kunjungan tersebut, Raja diterima sebagai Royal Confrater di Basilika Kepausan St. Paulus di Luar Tembok, dengan persetujuan Paus. Gelar kehormatan baru ini merupakan bentuk timbal balik atas gestur tersebut, yang mengubah rasa saling hormat menjadi simbol publik akan komitmen bersama kedua institusi tersebut terhadap kesatuan umat Kristiani.”

articles.title: A Commentary to Consider: The Celebration of Halloween
articles.content:
By Judith Ritchie
Free-lance writer
A Commentary

Summer has ended and winter is fast approaching. For those of us in this modern society, we tend to forget that this is harvest time and that our very lives depend upon a good harvest to get us through this next year. But in every culture throughout the world, the time of harvest has always been crucial to their survival.

In the early days in America, the settlers prayed throughout the winter for good weather for planting, plenty of sun and rain during the growing season, and for a good harvest in the autumn. Many prayed to the Christian God of the Bible, leaving their care and future in His hands. But throughout the history of the world, most people sought help from other gods; gods who demanded much more than just faith and prayer from the people.

Halloween, known in ancient Briton and Ireland as Samhain* (“Summer’s End”), is a time of worship to the ancient god Cromm Cruaich, also known as the “Bloody Crescent.”**  Unlike the God of the Bible, Cromm Cruaich did not accept simple prayers of faith for a good harvest; he demanded much more. Charles Squire records in his book Celtic Myth and Legend, an ancient poem concerning the god Cromm Cruaich.  Here are some excerpts from it:

“Here used to be

A high idol with many fights, which was named the Cromm Cruaich;

It made every tribe to be without peace.

“T was a sad evil!

Brave Gaels used to worship it…

“He was their god,

The withered Cromm with many mists…

“To him without glory

They would kill their piteous, wretched offspring

With much wailing and peril,

To pour their blood around CrommCruaich

“Milk and corn

They would ask from him speedily

In return for one-third of their healthy issue; [their children]

Great was the horror and the scare of him…

“To him

“They did evil…”

Cromm Cruaich demanded human sacrifice. He was a demonic, bloodthirsty god described as being “withered,” cloaked in darkness by “many mists,” and whose violence terrified the people. He was merciless, evil and brought much sadness, making everyone “to be without peace.” His sacrifices were on the “high places” and under the cloak of darkness. Children and adults were sacrificed to him and to the twelve lesser gods, which were represented by “standing stones” that were placed in a circle around his golden idol. Multitudes were sacrificed all at once. Charles Squire explains, “The same authority also tells us that these sacrifices were made at ‘Hallowe’en’, [or] ‘Samhain’-“Summer’s End”- when the sun’s power waned, and the strength of the gods of darkness, winter, and the underworld grew great.” Later, St. Patrick took a sledge hammer and destroyed the golden idol of Cromm Cruaich. This, then, is the origin of Halloween.

Unfortunately, we still honor this ancient celebration. And as we acknowledge and celebrate it, we are giving honor to a god who demanded the lives and blood of human beings. We are celebrating death, destruction, darkness, demons, violence, hatred, and evil. We are honoring a demon-god who used terror to control the people and whose demands caused strong, brave men to disgrace themselves.

In contrast, Jesus demands nothing from us but asks us to trust Him. He doesn’t demand the lives of our children to appease Him. The only thing that pleases Him is our faith. He is not a God of darkness, but rather Jesus Himself is light. He is a God of love, not fear; of healing and restoration, not violence and destruction. Jesus gives comfort, not terror, to those who look to Him for help. The early settlers who prayed to Him rested in His peace, as we do today, for He is the Prince of Peace. Jesus is the God and Creator of Life, not death. Since there is no evil in Jesus, He never brings harm or disgrace to those who worship Him, and He does not intimidate or deal unjustly. And where Cromm Cruaich is a demon-god, Jesus is holy, righteous, and pure.

The celebration of Halloween is quite obviously a celebration of darkness, death, fear, demons, hatred, violence, and evil. And yet, it’s one of the biggest celebrations of the year. What’s worse, without any thought to what they’re doing, many Christians celebrate it as well.

It is interesting to note that the writers of the ancient Celtic poem referred to Comm Cruaich as having “many mists.” In the same way, 2 Peter 2:17 speaks of those who have turned away from God as “…springs without water and mists driven by a storm, for whom the black darkness has been reserved forever.” This is the god of Halloween. This is whom we choose to ‘agree with’ when we participate, in any way at all, in this celebration.

God equates our relationship with Him to that of a marriage relationship. Many times in the Old Testament He accuses the nation of Israel of adultery and harlotry because of their involvement with spiritual practices other than those He has ordained. The prophet Isaiah pleads with Israel, “Come, house of Jacob, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.” But in the next verse, God tells them that He has abandoned them “because they are filled with influences from the east.” Is. 2:5-6

We know that God is the same yesterday, today, and forever and in the New Testament God continues to speak the same to us today:

 Do not be partakers with them; for you were formally darkness, but now you are Light in the Lord; walk as children of Light…do not participate in the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but instead, even expose them; for it is disgraceful even to speak of the things done by them in secret…therefore be careful how you walk, not as unwise men, but as wise, making the most of your time, because the days are evil. Eph. 5: 7-8, 11, 15-16

* Celtic Myth and Legend by Charles Squire

** Celtic Myths and Legends by T.W. Rolleston

——————————————–

Can Ivermectin play a key role in treating Neurological Disease?

A 2023 study published in Inflammation demonstrated that ivermectin mitigates neuro-inflammatory damage in a mouse model of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis. A 2024 study published in Cell & Bioscience reported that ivermectin increased activity of striatal cholinergic interneurons, thereby enhancing dopamine release via nicotinic receptor modulation (PMC11025261). Since cholinergic deficits underlie many cognitive symptoms in Alzheimer’s, Ivermectin’s indirect cholinergic enhancement may complement standard therapies.

articles.title: Paus Berdoa di hadapan Gambar Maria yang Berdusta
articles.content:
Sumber: www.wayoflife.org

“Para terkasih, janganlah mempercayai setiap roh, tetapi ujilah roh-roh itu, apakah berasal dari Allah. Sebab, banyak nabi palsu telah keluar ke dunia” (1 Yohanes 4:1). Pada tanggal 26 September 2026, Paus Leo XIV berdoa di hadapan patung “Bunda Maria dari Lourdes” di Prancis. Patung tersebut berada di sebuah gua tempat seorang gadis desa yang hampir buta huruf bernama Bernadette Soubirous konon mendapatkan penglihatan pada bulan Maret 1858 tentang seorang wanita muda yang mengaku sebagai “yang Dikandung Tanpa Noda” (Immaculate Conception). Peristiwa ini terjadi tiga tahun setelah Paus Pius IX secara resmi menyatakan bahwa Maria dikandung tanpa dosa. Padahal, Maria menyebut Allah sebagai Juruselamatnya (Lukas 1:47), yang membuktikan bahwa ia tidaklah bebas dari dosa. Satu-satunya pribadi yang lahir tanpa dosa adalah Tuhan Yesus Kristus (Ibrani 4:15; 7:26; 2 Korintus 5:21; 1 Petrus 2:22; 1 Yohanes 3:5).

Penglihatan tersebut tidak hanya berdusta mengenai status “tanpa noda” dan memerintahkan orang untuk berdoa rosario — yang di dalamnya terdapat doa menghujat yang ditujukan kepada Maria sebagai Ratu Surga, bunda belas kasih, dan penuh rahmat — tetapi juga mengajarkan keselamatan melalui perbuatan. Bernadette diperintahkan untuk mencium tanah sebagai “tindakan penanggungan bagi orang-orang berdosa.” Tidak ada disebutkan mengenai Injil yang sejati, yaitu tentang kematian, penguburan, dan kebangkitan Yesus Kristus demi pengampunan dosa. Roma menyatakan penglihatan Bernadette sebagai sesuatu yang otentik pada tahun 1862, sebuah patung didedikasikan untuk Maria yang “tak bernoda” pada tahun 1863, sebuah katedral diresmikan pada tahun 1876, dan Bernadette dikanonisasi sebagai orang kudus pada tahun 1933

Paus Yohanes Paulus II berdoa di hadapan patung Lourdes pada tahun 1983 dan mengaitkan keselamatannya dari upaya pembunuhan kepada perantaraan Maria. Paus Benediktus XVI meletakkan mahkota emas di atas kepala patung Maria dari Lourdes di Roma pada tahun 2007. Rasul Paulus memberitakan keselamatan melalui kasih karunia tanpa perbuatan (Efesus 2:8-10) dan memperingatkan bahwa siapa pun—bahkan seorang malaikat dari surga — yang memberitakan Injil yang berbeda dari Injil kasih karunia cuma-cuma, akan terkutuk (Galatia 1:6-9). Roma membangun tiga basilika di Lourdes serta mengumpulkan persembahan dan berbagai pemberian berharga dari 200 juta peziarah yang datang mencari berkat dan kesembuhan di sana. Mereka yang menjalin hubungan dengan Roma berarti melibatkan diri dalam kegelapan rohani yang pekat serta penyesatan, yang merupakan bentuk ketidaktaatan langsung terhadap 2 Korintus 6:14-19.

articles.title: Buku Baru Karya Paul Young – “Return to the Shack”
articles.content:
Sumber: www.wayoflife.org

Berikut ini adalah kutipan singkat dari A Self-Confessed Universalist and His Return to the Shack: 10 Critical Warnings (Seorang yang Mengaku Universalis dan Kembalinya Ia ke The Shack: 10 Peringatan Kritis), karya William B. Smith, 6 Oktober 2026, LighthouseTrailsResearch.com:

The Shack kembali hadir! Bersamaan dengan buku baru karya Young, Return to the Shack, ajaran sesat dan tipu daya pun turut kembali. Penuh dengan drama dan emosi, Return to the Shack telah menjadi novel terlaris — padahal baru saja dirilis. William Young mengatakan, “Salah satu keistimewaan menulis fiksi adalah Anda bisa mengambil kebebasan kreatif yang tidak bisa dilakukan dalam karya nonfiksi,” dan itulah tepatnya yang dilakukan Young dalam novel terlarisnya, The Shack. Ia pun terus melakukan hal yang sama dalam bukunya tahun 2026, Return to the Shack. Namun, tidak ada hal yang patut dipuji dari tindakan mengambil kebebasan yang tidak semestinya untuk menulis novel “Kristen” yang mempermainkan emosi pembaca demi mendukung jenis Kekristenan “baru” yang sebenarnya sama sekali bukan Kekristenan.

Sekilas, Return to the Shack adalah kisah tentang kekuatan pengampunan dan perlunya menghapuskan hukuman mati. Alurnya berkembang saat tokoh utamanya, Mackenzie Allen Phillips, bertemu dengan pembunuh putrinya yang sedang menunggu eksekusi di sebuah penjara di Nashville. … Setelah menyuguhkan berbagai air mata dan drama dalam ceritanya — di saat para pembaca yang tidak curiga menjadi terbuka dan rentan terhadap sugesti — Young melontarkan gagasan sesat ala New Age. Mengutip temannya, C. Baxter Kruger, Young menulis: “Pengakuan akan kehadiran sakral Bapa, Anak, dan Roh Kudus dalam setiap pribadi, tempat, dan peristiwa, adalah permulaan dari Hikmat.”

Dengan menyatakan bahwa Allah, Yesus, dan Roh Kudus berada “di dalam” setiap orang, dan bahwa pemahaman ini merupakan “permulaan dari hikmat,” Young berupaya meyakinkan para pembacanya bahwa ajaran keliru ini adalah kebenaran. Akan tetapi, ini adalah kebohongan mendasar yang sama yang menjadi inti dari gerakan New Age. Hal ini sangat bertentangan dengan Alkitab, yang menyatakan bahwa “takut akan TUHAN adalah permulaan hikmat” (Amsal 9:10) — bukan distorsi ala New Age dari Young dan Kruger terhadap ayat Alkitab yang penting tersebut. Tampak jelas bahwa orang-orang ini tidak memiliki rasa takut akan Tuhan, karena mereka menaruh kata-kata pilihan mereka sendiri ke dalam mulut siapa pun yang mereka kehendaki — entah itu Allah, Yesus, Roh Kudus, atau bahkan tetangga sebelah rumah mereka. Ayat-ayat berikut hanyalah sebagian kecil dari banyak ayat dalam Alkitab yang menunjukkan bahwa Roh Kudus tidak berada “di dalam” setiap orang, melainkan merupakan suatu “karunia” yang diberikan kepada mereka yang percaya dan mengikut Tuhan: “Maka Petrus berkata kepada mereka: Bertobatlah dan hendaklah tiap-tiap kalian dibaptis dalam nama Yesus Kristus untuk pengampunan dosa, maka kalian akan menerima karunia Roh Kudus” (Kisah Para Rasul 2:38). Lihat juga Lukas 11:13 dan Kisah Para Rasul 5:32.

articles.title: Gurun Pernikahan di Amerika
articles.content:
Sumber: www.wayoflife.org

Berikut ini adalah kutipan dari artikel “Keluarga tradisional dengan dua orang tua kian menghilang” (“Traditional two-parent families vanish”), Fox News, 13 Oktober 2026:

Keluarga inti tradisional dengan dua orang tua jauh lebih jarang ditemukan di sebagian wilayah kota-kota besar di Amerika dibandingkan di kawasan pinggiran kota. Menurut sebuah laporan baru, di beberapa lingkungan di Cleveland, Washington D.C., Milwaukee, dan Detroit, kurang dari seperempat rumah tangga yang memiliki anak dipimpin oleh pasangan yang terikat dalam pernikahan. Studi dari Institute for Family Studies menunjukkan bahwa proporsi rumah tangga dengan anak yang dipimpin oleh pasangan menikah memiliki selisih sekitar 70 poin persentase di berbagai wilayah yang diteliti. Hal ini menyoroti kesenjangan antara ‘gurun keluarga menikah’ (married-family deserts) di perkotaan dan ‘taman keluarga menikah’ (married-family gardens) di pinggiran kota. …

Wilayah pinggiran Dallas-Fort Worth merupakan ‘taman keluarga menikah’ terbesar di Amerika Serikat, sementara Lower Manhattan dan Brooklyn membentuk ‘gurun keluarga menikah’ terbesar, yang mencakup hampir 686.000 kepala keluarga, di mana lebih dari dua pertiganya tidak terikat dalam pernikahan. … Anak-anak yang tumbuh di ‘taman keluarga menikah’ dibesarkan oleh orang tua yang menikah, di lingkungan tempat tinggal, sekolah, dan kegiatan luar sekolah di mana sebagian besar teman sebaya mereka mengalami hal yang sama. Studi tersebut menjelaskan bahwa anak-anak ini ‘akan melihat pernikahan sebagai sesuatu yang stabil dan lazim dalam kehidupan orang dewasa.’ Sebaliknya, bagi anak-anak di ‘gurun keluarga menikah’, stabilitas hubungan orang dewasa cenderung jauh lebih fluktuatif, dan pengawasan terhadap anak pun lebih tidak konsisten. Di lingkungan seperti ini, pernikahan dan ikatan hubungan yang stabil merupakan hal yang tidak lazim atau jauh dari norma sehari-hari—baik bagi anak-anak tersebut maupun teman sebaya mereka.” …

Wilayah dengan proporsi rumah tangga yang dipimpin oleh pasangan menikah terendah di Amerika Serikat antara lain Cleveland bagian timur dan wilayah di dekatnya, Bratenahl Village, Ohio, dengan angka hanya 18%. Diikuti oleh Washington D.C. bagian timur sebesar 20%, dan Milwaukee bagian tengah sebesar 22%. Sementara itu, di kawasan pinggiran kota yang disebut sebagai ‘taman keluarga menikah’—seperti Fremont City di California, Lakewood di New Jersey, dan beberapa bagian lainnya… Di Utah County, Utah, hingga 89% rumah tangga yang memiliki anak dikepalai oleh pasangan suami-istri.

Editor: Alkitab memberitahu kita bahwa salah satu tujuan dari pernikahan adalah untuk mendapatkan generasi (anak-anak) yang berikutnya yang beriman. “Dan kamu bertanya: Oleh karena apa? Oleh sebab TUHAN telah menjadi saksi antara engkau dan isteri masa mudamu yang kepadanya engkau telah tidak setia, padahal dialah teman sekutumu dan isteri seperjanjianmu. Bukankah Allah yang Esa menjadikan mereka daging dan roh? Dan apakah yang dikehendaki kesatuan itu? Keturunan ilahi! Jadi jagalah dirimu! Dan janganlah orang tidak setia terhadap isteri dari masa mudanya” (Maleakhi 3:14-15). Ketika suatu keluarga rusak (misalnya dengan meninggalkan pasangan dari masa muda), maka yang paling menjadi korban adalah anak-anak.

articles.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
articles.content:
Expect to see quite a few websites serving error pages today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.

Image: Shutterstock.com, Sashkin.

The flaws at issue are present in PHP, the programming language that powers sites running on a large number of web publishing systems, including Drupal, Magento, Joomla and WordPress. Earlier today, PHP released an emergency security update to fix two critical bugs that can allow an attacker to execute code of their choosing on a vulnerable server.

Reuters reports that government websites in Europe and elsewhere went offline today after the PHP vulnerabilities were disclosed. Cloudflare said it has already detected some exploitation of the flaw, and that at 3:02 am (UTC) it implemented web application firewall rules to protect websites from attack traffic seeking to exploit the bugs, which could cause a denial of service condition, remote code execution, and data exposure.

OpenAI, which was involved in the vulnerability research and outreach, said “given the severity of these flaws and PHP’s widespread use, we consider this one of the most impactful security issues in recent memory.”

Censys, a company that tracks the technology used by Internet hosts, said a recent scan identified approximately 2.58 million Internet facing hosts and 54.9 million web properties running PHP.

Security experts at Wiz said every PHP version released in the last decade is affected by at least one of these vulnerabilities [full disclosure: Wiz is an advertiser on this blog].

“These findings rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history,” reads a blog post published today by a team of researchers at Wiz, which was one of several organizations credited with discovering the vulnerabilities. “The underlying flaws had been present for decades, but demonstrating their exploitability required an exceptionally complex chain of steps, at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve. Frontier AI models substantially reduced that barrier, turning a longstanding flaw into an exploit.”

The Wiz researchers say it is likely the PHP vulnerabilities will be mass-exploited to install web-based backdoors or “web shells,” which give attackers a web-based panel that allows them to remotely control infected sites. Wiz said that prior to the PHP bugs being publicly disclosed, the company worked with the PHP team, Calif and OpenAI to measure the size of the problem and coordinate patch verification and disclosure.

The PHP zero-day vulnerabilities are being tracked by their CVE numbers, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, and they affect all web servers running PHP 5.4 or later. The bugs are fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35.

According to Wiz, PHP is so deeply embedded in many web applications that we are likely to see organizations struggling to patch these vulnerabilities for some time to come, comparing this PHP vulnerability pair with the Log4Shell weakness that emerged in 2021 — a widespread, severe-as-it-gets security flaw in Log4j, a popular Java logging framework.

“A vulnerability in core PHP reaches far beyond a single application,” the Wiz researchers wrote. “PHP runs across clouds, hosting providers, content-delivery networks and millions of independently managed servers. Reducing exposure before the technical details became public required coordinated work across that entire ecosystem.”

The SANS Internet Storm Center is keeping an eye on major software platforms that are shipping updates to deal with these PHP flaws. For example, Ubuntu just released updated PHP packages. For a technical deep-dive on these vulnerabilities that tells the timeline of the discovery of these bugs in a comic book style, check out this post from Calif, another technology company credited with finding the PHP flaws.

A snapshot of php2shell.censys.com, the website Censys set up to track the PHP vulnerabilities.

This is a fast-moving story. Updates will be noted here with timestamps.

Update, 2:30 pm ET: Add figures from Censys and a link to Calif’s writeup.

2. Potent Anti-Inflammatory: Works like aspirin or ibuprofen without trashing your gut. It tames swelling and pain naturally.

7. Scar Tissue Softener: Helps dissolve and loosen up scar tissue and stiffness after surgeries or injuries. We can use in conjunction with homeopathic thiosinaminum.

The Transdermal Superhighway Effect of DMSO

DMSO’s ability to integrate seamlessly with other natural treatments amplifies its appeal to those pursuing holistic health. By combining DMSO with castor oil, aloe vera, vitamin C, colloidal silver, cayenne, magnesium, CBD oil, or many other botanical medicines, users can experience enhanced effects that address not just symptoms but also the underlying causes of health issues. For anyone looking to take control of their health, this synergistic combination approach offers a path forward.

[A number of the recipes to follow are from Dr. Amelia White’s independently published book, The Complete DMSO Healing Bible.]

These recipe combinations reflect DMSO’s versatility and adaptability in addressing a broad-spectrum of health concerns naturally. DMSO represents a shift away from reliance on pharmaceutical interventions and toward preventative health and medical independence. Its use encourages individuals to take an active role in their well-being by exploring safe, natural solutions that align with the body’s innate biology.

Healing with Natural DMSO Combinations

While many natural substances could be mixed with DMSO, AMD mentions about 120 that have been primarily focused on, many of which were chosen due to their existing popularity within the natural medicine field, and a smaller number of which were adopted due to their unique synergies with DMSO. They are as follows:

Carrier Oils and Topical Bases — Aloe Vera, Castor Oil, Coconut Oil, Shea Butter, organic GF Beef Tallow, MCT Oil, EV Olive Oil, Jojoba Oil, Sesame Oil (links provided so you can read more)

Many of these carrier oils also have a variety of other therapeutic properties, which make them popular to use with DMSO (e.g., for skin, prostate, musculoskeletal, or eye issues, along with wound healing, burns, cataracts, Complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS), Alzheimer’s, and hernias). Generally, these combinations aim to extenuate the known properties of the oils. Some treat a variety of infections, many are used for musculoskeletal issues and reducing inflammation, others treat a variety of types of pain such as headaches and sciatica, while others improve circulation, parasympathetic tone, anxiety, digestion, and autoimmune conditions like asthma and psoriasis. Additionally, DMSO lowers the amount of the essential oil needed and makes it much easier to treat conditions that affect the skin and underlying tissues (e.g., infections).

Healing Botanicals 

Arnica, Comfrey, Turmeric, Black Cumin Seed Oil, Cayenne Pepper, Sea Vegetables, White Willow Bark, Lemon Balm, Eyebright, Hawthorn or Heart Health, your CBD Oil, Amygdalin (as apricot seeds), Nettles, Saw Palmetto, Sulforaphane (from broccoli sprouts), Black Salve Extract, Horse Chestnut (for varicose veins), Ginger, Green Tea Extract, Dandelion, Neem Oil, Passion Flower for restful sleep, and Ginkgo for concentration and memory. A few of these have remarkable anti-inflammatory properties, are excellent for healing injuries or pain, and frequently are far more effective than standard preparations of the herb.
